exception_text: Prior authorization request is missing supporting clinical notes for outpatient surgical procedure.
supporting_evidence: Electronic prior-auth checklist confirms request submitted without required clinical encounter notes; automated provider document request dispatched.

exception_text: Post-service inpatient claim received without the itemized hospital billing schedule.
supporting_evidence: UB-04 billing summary attached but revenue code itemization schedule is absent from submission.

exception_text: Subscriber name on prior authorization differs from eligibility record (Kathryn M Davis vs Katherine Davis).
supporting_evidence: Member ID matches exactly; phonetic variation in first name requires operator verification against master MPI.

exception_text: Medical report contains non-standard oncology terminology that OCR extraction could not parse with sufficient confidence.
supporting_evidence: Novel immunotherapy regimen and stage IV staging details could not be matched against standard formulary guidelines.

exception_text: Claim contains potentially altered facility invoice with mismatched line-item arithmetic and duplicate service dates.
supporting_evidence: Digital PDF font anomalies detected; total billed charges do not equal sum of procedure codes; routed to SIU.

exception_text: Prior authorization for MRI lumbar spine missing required 6-week conservative physical therapy documentation.
supporting_evidence: Clinical guideline MCG-LUM-04 requires documented 6 weeks of conservative therapy before advanced imaging authorization.

exception_text: Servicing provider NPI on authorization differs from contracted group practice registry.
supporting_evidence: Provider Dr. Marcus Vance billing under individual NPI 1285901234 instead of contracted group practice NPI 1942857102.

exception_text: Hospital discharge summary is partially corrupted or truncated in electronic transmission.
supporting_evidence: Page 2 of 4 failed transmission checksum; automated re-transmission request issued via provider portal.

exception_text: Conventional 30-year loan application is missing the most recent 30 consecutive days of borrower paystubs.
supporting_evidence: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-3.1 requires paystub dated within 30 days of application; borrower portal upload pending.

exception_text: Primary borrower W-2 form for tax year 2023 is missing from uploaded application package.
supporting_evidence: AUS finding DU-104 requires 2 years W-2; 2022 provided but 2023 missing.

exception_text: Borrower name on purchase contract differs from Uniform Residential Loan Application (Robert J Miller vs Bob Miller).
supporting_evidence: Name on government photo ID matches 1003; requires underwriter validation and contract addendum.

exception_text: Borrower monthly base income on 1003 ($9,500) conflicts with year-to-date average on submitted paystub ($8,100).
supporting_evidence: Discrepancy of $1,400/month affects DTI calculation (41% vs 46%); underwriter must verify paystub and propose field correction.

exception_text: Self-employed borrower tax returns show complex multi-tiered K-1 partnership distributions that standard extraction rules cannot qualify.
supporting_evidence: Complex partnership structure across 4 entities requires cash flow analysis worksheet (Form 1084) by senior underwriter.

exception_text: Submitted bank statement PDF contains metadata indicating digital modification and altered deposit entries.
supporting_evidence: PDF Producer tag reveals third-party editor; inconsistent transaction running balances detected; referred to fraud risk unit.

exception_text: Property hazard insurance binder missing mortgagee clause and required deductible confirmation.
supporting_evidence: Closing condition C-12 requires active insurance binder listing lender as loss payee.

exception_text: Title commitment reveals an unreleased prior mortgage lien from 2018 requiring clearing.
supporting_evidence: Schedule B-1 requirement requires formal deed of reconveyance or payoff documentation from prior lender.
